title: Entity
description: A kind of thing a domain knows about. It owns its attributes and its named instances. A shopper, a borrower, and an advisor are instances of person. A merchant, a processor, a lender, a buyer, a target, and an advisory firm are instances of organization. They are not separate entities, and they are not domains. A connection that carries data of its own, such as a cart line, a loan condition, a citation, or a membership, is an entity too. Actions this entity can take are behavior and are not part of this schema.

id.description: Stable id of this kind of thing.

attributes.description: Facts each instance of this entity can hold.

instances.description: Named particulars of this entity. Buyer, target, and advisor are three instances of one organization entity.

instance.description: One particular thing of this entity, such as one firm or one person.

values.description: Attribute values, keyed by attribute name.
